boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Allendale campus spaces for quiet work, group projects, peer help, informal gatherings, climbing, and time outdoors.

cards.title: Reconfigure the Atrium for the Work at Hand
cards.subtitle: Moveable furniture and whiteboards for solo or group work
cards.notes: Bring a small group, move the furniture into a useful layout, and use the whiteboards to sketch a plan before dividing the work.
cards.short_summary: An adaptable library workspace where students can shift quickly between independent tasks and group planning.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU says the Mary Idema Pew Library Atrium has moveable furniture, whiteboards, floor-to-ceiling windows, and space for group or solo work.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces by Building - University Libraries
cards.access_notes: The university says Mary Idema Pew Library study spaces are available whenever the library is open; consult current library hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Mary Idema Pew Library Reading Rooms
cards.title: Take Focused Work to the Reading Rooms
cards.subtitle: Quiet rooms on the library’s third and fourth floors
cards.notes: Choose a work table or cubicle when conversation would be distracting; try the third floor if a fireplace-side setting helps you settle in.
cards.short_summary: Two quiet upper-floor rooms designed for concentrated reading and individual work.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU identifies quiet Reading Rooms on floors three and four with work tables and cubicles, plus a 20-foot fireplace in the third-floor room.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces by Building - University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located on floors three and four of Mary Idema Pew Library and available subject to current library building hours.

cards.entity_name: Mary Idema Pew Library Innovation Zone
cards.title: Make the Project Visible in the Innovation Zone
cards.subtitle: Flexible third-floor seating with whiteboard walls
cards.notes: Use the whiteboard walls to externalize ideas, rearrange the flexible seating, and leave with a photographed outline of the group’s decisions.
cards.short_summary: A third-floor project area suited to visual brainstorming and collaborative problem-solving.
cards.evidence_claim: The university describes the third-floor Innovation Zone as having flexible seating, whiteboard walls, and manipulatives intended to spark creativity.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces by Building - University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located on the third floor of Mary Idema Pew Library; use is subject to current library hours and posted space rules.

cards.entity_name: Mary Idema Pew Library Reading Garden
cards.title: Move a Reading Session into the Open Air
cards.subtitle: A seasonal outdoor space inside the library’s third floor
cards.notes: Bring reading or low-tech work on a suitable weather day, then use the indoor third-floor spaces as a backup if the garden is unavailable.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal courtyard-like study setting tucked into the center of the library.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU identifies the Reading Garden as a seasonal outdoor space located in the center of Mary Idema Pew Library’s third floor.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces by Building - University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Seasonal and weather-dependent; enter through Mary Idema Pew Library during current building hours and follow any posted closure notices.

cards.entity_name: Mary Idema Pew Library Roof Terrace
cards.title: Use the Roof Terrace for a Change of Scene
cards.subtitle: Good-weather study seating above Mary Idema Pew Library
cards.notes: Save this space for a dry, mild day and bring work that will not blow away; check posted access conditions before settling in.
cards.short_summary: An elevated outdoor study option for students who want fresh air without leaving the library.
cards.evidence_claim: The university says the roof terrace atop Mary Idema Pew Library provides good-weather study spots and views across campus.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces by Building - University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Weather-dependent and accessible only when the library permits terrace use; check current building hours and posted notices.

cards.title: Bring a Draft to the Knowledge Market
cards.subtitle: Peer consultation for research, writing, presentations, and digital work
cards.notes: Arrive with a draft, question, or project goal so a peer consultant can help you improve a specific part of the work in one-on-one or small-group time.
cards.short_summary: A peer-supported workspace for strengthening academic and digital projects before submission or presentation.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU says Knowledge Market peer consultants work one-on-one or with small groups on research, writing, presentations, and digital skills.
cards.source_title: Mary Idema Pew Library - University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located in Mary Idema Pew Library; consult the Knowledge Market’s current service schedule and appointment information before visiting.

cards.title: Use Kirkhof as the Group’s Campus Base
cards.subtitle: A central student center built for gathering and engagement
cards.notes: Meet here when a group needs a recognizable starting point, then check room rules or Event Services requirements before occupying reservable space.
cards.short_summary: A central student-union setting for informal connection, organization work, and scheduled campus activities.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU states that the Kirkhof Center provides students space to gather, create, and engage and serves more than 400 registered student organizations.
cards.source_title: Russel H. Kirkhof Center - Kirkhof Center Operations and Event Services
cards.access_notes: Informal and reservable areas have different conditions; check current building hours and reserve designated rooms through Event Services when required.

cards.title: Follow the Arboretum’s Loop for an Outdoor Reset
cards.subtitle: A landscaped campus path near Au Sable Hall
cards.notes: Enter through the flower-covered archway, follow the circulating path, and choose only established open areas for a brief break or quiet study.
cards.short_summary: A recognizable campus green space where students can walk, pause, or spend time outdoors between classes.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU Student Life describes entering the Arboretum through its flower-covered archway, walking the path around it, and encountering students hammocking there.
cards.source_title: Choose Your Own Adventure: Find Louie! - Student Life Weekly
cards.access_notes: Use established paths and open areas, observe posted campus rules, and avoid attaching hammocks where restrictions or tree-protection guidance prohibit it.

cards.title: Take an Established Trail Through the Ravines
cards.subtitle: Campus nature trails extending along the Allendale ravines
cards.notes: Choose an established access point near the Arboretum or South Apartments, stay on marked routes, and allow enough daylight for the return walk.
cards.short_summary: A campus-spanning trail network that offers students a longer outdoor break beside the ravine landscape.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU Student Life says the Ravines extend north to south across the Allendale campus and have trails accessible from points including the Arboretum and South Apartments.
cards.source_title: Take a Hike to these 4 Gorgeous Hiking Trails - Student Life Weekly
cards.access_notes: Stay on established trails, use daylight and weather-appropriate precautions, and contact GVSU Facilities regarding trail-maintenance concerns.

cards.title: Try a Drop-In Session at the Climbing Center
cards.subtitle: Top-rope, bouldering, and Kilter Board climbing in Finkelstein Athletic Village
cards.notes: Create an account and complete the appropriate waiver before arriving, then ask staff for the required orientation and properly fitted rental equipment.
cards.short_summary: A supervised indoor climbing space where students can share routes across several climbing formats.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU documents a 26.5-foot wall with ten top-rope stations, lead lines, bouldering, and an adjustable Kilter Board, with open climbing available to the GVSU community and public.
cards.source_title: Climbing Center - Recreation & Wellness | Outdoor Adventures
cards.access_notes: Check current open-climb hours. Participants must complete the applicable waiver; minors require a parent or legal guardian’s signature. Payment may apply outside eligible GVSU affiliations.
